comments.body:
Fixed by #797 (merged, `5d12b24fc7`).

- A new request never covers the one on screen: the child's command prompt now waits under the parent's question ("Another request is waiting; it shows after you answer this one.") and shows after it.
- Keys (and pastes) that reach a request before it was drawn, or within 1 s of it first showing (or of the last dropped key), are dropped, Esc included; only Ctrl+C acts at once. The prompt says "Keys pressed as this request appeared were ignored. Choose an option with ↑/↓, then enter" and needs navigation before Enter. This covers exec, patch, permissions and MCP approvals, MCP forms and links, questions and Claude-pane approvals, and the next request of a prompt's queue.

Replay of Q11b (GLM 5.3 Flash, disposable home): Down, Enter answered the question; a second Down, Enter as the child's prompt appeared was ignored; nothing was approved, no "don't ask again" rule was saved and `ks-child.txt` wasn't written. [Video](https://github.com/CorbanuCore/CorbanuTerminal/releases/download/demos/issue-787-issue787-new-prompt-ignores-early-keys-b84f7fed7b3f-2026-10-14.mp4); screens in `qa/security-levels/fixes/issue-787-20261014/`.

This is UI input handling at every level; what runs and what is denied are unchanged.
Owner decision (Travis, 2026-10-14, all as recommended): keep the 1-second key guard at every level (Permissive included) and keep Esc ignored in that first second (Ctrl+C still acts).

title: Approval prompt: a Down+Enter meant for one prompt approves a child's command prompt that appeared 0.8 s earlier (incl. "don't ask again")
